newsitem.title: FRANCE: French truckers block Paris roads in tax protest.
newsitem.headline: French truckers block Paris roads in tax protest.

text.p: Truckers blocked several key access roads into the French capital early on Thursday in a protest over fuel taxes but the authorities said traffic backups were no worse than usual for a rainy Paris morning.

Hundreds of lorry drivers used their vehicles to block off several key arteries into eastern Paris and tie up the Paris ring road, but many suburban commuters -- who had been forewarned -- left early for work or took alternative routes.

The National Road Transport Federation (FNTR) and the National Union of Road Transporter Associations (UNOSTRA) had predicted that 600 to 1,000 drivers would participate in the protest to press their demands for lower taxes on diesel fuel.

The two unions, which represent drivers from about half of France's 35,000 road transport firms, argue that taxes on diesel fuel are lower for other professions including taxi drivers, fishing boats, and farmers.
